title: Implement admin backend system, payment gateway integrations, and professional UI/logo redesign

requirements.text: Create comprehensive admin authentication system in backend allowing admin login through backend actor methods with role-based access control to distinguish admin users from regular users

quotes: admin shd login from backend and manage frontend

acceptanceCriteria: Backend actor includes admin authentication methods
Admin role is stored and verified in backend state
Admin principals are separately managed from regular user principals
Admin authentication persists across sessions

requirements.text: Build admin theme management system allowing admins to select and customize theme settings including color schemes, typography, and layout preferences that apply globally to the frontend

quotes: admin shd login from backend and manage frontend make changes to everything like thene selection

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores theme configuration with color scheme options
Admin interface includes theme selection controls
Theme changes apply immediately across all user sessions
Theme settings include light/dark mode and custom color palettes

requirements.text: Implement admin page management system allowing admins to enable/disable pages, reorder navigation menu items, and modify page visibility for all users from the admin panel
acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores page visibility and ordering configuration
Admin panel includes page management interface
Changes to page visibility reflect immediately in user navigation
Page reordering updates the sidebar menu dynamically

requirements.text: Create admin subscription pricing management interface allowing admins to update subscription pricing, change billing intervals, and modify plan features without code changes
acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores subscription pricing configuration
Admin interface includes pricing editor with amount and interval fields
Pricing changes apply to new subscriptions immediately
Subscribe page displays current pricing from backend configuration

requirements.text: Build payment gateway integration system supporting Stripe, Razorpay, Coinbase Commerce, and NOWPayments with admin interface for configuring API keys and secret keys for each gateway without requiring code deployment

quotes: add payment gateway - APIkeys for Stripe , Razorpay, coinbase commerce, now payment it shd be ready to use admin can just add api and secret key to add payment gateway

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores encrypted API keys and secrets for all four payment gateways
Admin panel includes secure form for entering API credentials for each gateway
Payment gateway can be enabled/disabled by admin
System automatically uses configured gateway credentials for payment processing
API key validation confirms credentials are correct before saving

requirements.text: Create admin payment management dashboard displaying all transactions, subscriptions, refunds, and payment statuses in real-time with filtering, search, and export capabilities
acceptanceCriteria: Backend provides query methods for retrieving all payment transactions
Admin dashboard displays transaction list with date, user, amount, gateway, and status
Real-time updates show new transactions without page refresh
Admin can filter transactions by date range, status, and payment gateway
Admin can export payment data as CSV or PDF

requirements.text: Redesign application logo to be impressive, professional, and modern with clean lines and a distinctive visual identity that represents prop trading and financial management

quotes: Make UI & Logo Impressive and proffessional

acceptanceCriteria: New logo is displayed in sidebar navigation
Logo appears on landing page header
Logo maintains quality at different sizes
Logo design is professional and suitable for financial platform

requirements.text: Upgrade UI design to professional standards with polished visual hierarchy, refined spacing, sophisticated color palette, premium typography, and smooth animations throughout all pages and components

quotes: Make UI & Logo Impressive and proffessional

acceptanceCriteria: All pages use consistent spacing and alignment
Color palette conveys professionalism and trust
Typography is readable and hierarchically clear
Interactive elements have smooth hover and transition effects
Cards and containers have refined shadows and borders
Overall design feels premium and production-ready

requirements.text: Implement full functionality for Payouts module allowing users to add, edit, and delete payout records with prop firm selection, date, amount, and currency, and display payout history table with sorting and filtering

quotes: all moduels shd be live and working as added to dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores payout records linked to user accounts
Users can add payout with form including prop firm, date, amount, currency
Payout history displays as sortable table
Users can edit and delete existing payouts
Summary statistics calculate total payouts correctly

requirements.text: Implement full functionality for Expenses module allowing users to add expenses with category selection (business or personal), subcategory, date, amount, and description, and display categorized expense summaries with monthly breakdowns

quotes: all moduels shd be live and working as added to dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores expense records with categories
Users can add expenses using category dropdowns as specified in earlier requirements
Expense list displays with edit and delete options
Summary shows total business and personal expenses separately
Monthly breakdown chart displays expense trends

requirements.text: Implement full functionality for Trading Overview module allowing users to manually enter trade data including entry/exit prices, lot size, profit/loss, and display comprehensive trading statistics with equity curve visualization

quotes: all moduels shd be live and working as added to dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores individual trade records linked to prop firm accounts
Users can add trades with all required fields
Dashboard calculates win rate, profit factor, and other metrics from trade data
Equity curve chart renders based on actual trade history
Statistics update in real-time as trades are added

requirements.text: Implement full functionality for Tools page calculators (Risk Calculator, Margin Calculator, P/L Calculator, Lot Size Calculator, Swap Calculator) with all input fields, real-time calculation logic, and result displays working correctly

quotes: all moduels shd be live and working as added to dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Risk Calculator accepts CFD pair, entry price, stop-loss, lot size and calculates risk percentage
Margin Calculator computes required margin based on inputs
P/L Calculator shows profit or loss based on entry/exit prices
Lot Size Calculator determines appropriate position size
Swap Calculator computes overnight financing charges
All calculators display results immediately as inputs change

requirements.text: Implement full functionality for Reviews & Disputes module allowing users to submit prop firm reviews with ratings and text, and file disputes with category selection, description, and evidence upload, with backend storage and display of submission history

quotes: all moduels shd be live and working as added to dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores review submissions with firm, rating, title, and content
Users can submit reviews using the form on Reviews & Disputes page
Backend stores dispute records with category, description, and status
Users can file disputes and view their status
Review and dispute history displays user's previous submissions

requirements.text: Implement full functionality for Compounding calculator allowing users to input starting capital, return percentage, compounding frequency, and time period, and display projected growth chart with detailed breakdown table

quotes: all moduels shd be live and working as added to dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Input fields accept starting capital, return rate, frequency, and duration
Calculator computes compound growth using correct formula
Growth chart visualizes capital growth over time
Breakdown table shows period-by-period growth values
Results update immediately when inputs change

requirements.text: Implement full functionality for Income Tax Calculator with country selection dropdown, income input fields (professional and prop payout income), automated tax calculation based on country-specific tax brackets, and display of detailed tax breakdown with estimated quarterly payments

quotes: all moduels shd be live and working as added to dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Country dropdown includes major countries with tax rules stored in backend
Users can enter professional income and prop payout income separately
Calculator applies correct tax brackets and rates for selected country
Tax breakdown displays applicable brackets, deductions, and total liability
Quarterly payment estimates show amounts and due dates

requirements.text: Implement full functionality for Exchange converters (FX and Crypto) with real-time rate fetching, currency selection dropdowns, amount input, and immediate conversion result display

quotes: all moduels shd be live and working as added to dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: FX converter supports major currency pairs with live rates
Crypto converter supports BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC to fiat currencies
Rates update automatically at regular intervals
Conversion calculates immediately when amount or currency changes
Display shows exchange rate and converted amount clearly

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or useInternetIdentity.tsx
Do not edit frontend/src/components/ui/* files directly
Backend must remain single-actor architecture in backend/main.mo
Admin authentication must integrate with existing Internet Identity system
Payment gateway API keys must be stored securely and encrypted in backend
All theme changes must respect existing Tailwind CSS configuration structure
nonGoals: Implementing Rust, Python, or other non-Motoko backend languages
Using Vue, Angular, or other frontend frameworks instead of React
Integrating third-party authentication beyond Internet Identity
Adding WebSocket or real-time chat features
Implementing SMS, email, or push notification services
Adding GPS, maps, or geolocation features
Integrating MetaMask or other Web3 wallets beyond Stripe payments

required: Professional prop trading logo with modern design, clean lines, and financial theme representing trading and portfolio management (propfolio-logo.dim_400x120.png)
